verdict.rationale: Supabase's own materials say every project is "a full Postgres database" and "100% portable" (supabase-docs-51, supabase-docs-77), which implies standard Postgres access. A community user reports managing migrations with the external tool dbmate instead of Supabase's built-in migrations (supabase-comm-8), which suggests direct database connectivity. However, nothing in the pack explicitly documents a connection string or support for standard drivers and ORMs. missing for 10: explicit connection-string documentation, connection pooler/direct-connection details, named ORM/driver integration guides (e.g., Prisma, Drizzle, psql), independent hands-on corroboration of connecting via a connection string.
